purpose: Evaluate whether the actual-position holding model improves exit/hold decisions without using future information or fabricated inputs.

required_data.daily_ohlc: legally reusable, provenance-identified TWSE/TPEx daily OHLC
required_data.security_master: historical supported-security classification; ordinary stock model only
required_data.corporate_actions: ex-right/ex-dividend, capital reduction, split, new-listing/reference-price discontinuities
required_data.risk_states: attention/disposition/suspension and other model-relevant restrictions valid for each session
required_data.market_context: the same verified 9+3 context contract used by production holding logic where historically available

position_episode_generation.method: deterministic historical pseudo-positions generated only from information available on or before each entry date
position_episode_generation.entry_dates: sample supported securities across multiple market regimes and entry dates; no cherry-picking by future outcome
position_episode_generation.cost_basis: official entry-session executable price rule fixed before OOS; cost is not optimized to improve later exit results
position_episode_generation.initial_shares: normalized shares for signal evaluation; monetary P/L may use a fixed notional. Share count must not alter the exit signal.
position_episode_generation.holding_age: derived from episode entry date exactly as production TW-holding-exit-v3 derives lookback
position_episode_generation.episode_overlap: no overlapping episode for the same security in the same test stream unless the protocol explicitly treats it as one continuing position

evaluation.decision_frequency: once per completed official trading session; no intraday information unless a separately licensed production feed exists
evaluation.execution: an exit condition observed at completed-session close may execute no earlier than the next legally tradable session using the frozen execution rule
comparators: buy-and-hold through the episode evaluation window
metrics: profit capture ratio when definable without look-ahead in the decision rule

split_and_statistics.split: chronological development period followed by untouched OOS period
split_and_statistics.walk_forward: required when enough licensed history exists
split_and_statistics.confidence_intervals: bootstrap or another documented resampling method on security/episode clusters

required: minimum OOS episode and security counts pass
no material look-ahead or survivorship defect found
production formula hash/version matches tested formula
net-of-cost outcome is not materially worse than both frozen baselines on primary risk-adjusted measures
no catastrophic tail-risk deterioration relative to baselines
prohibited: declaring PASS from win rate alone
retuning thresholds on the untouched OOS set
dropping losing securities/episodes after seeing results
converting INSUFFICIENT to PASS because the UI needs a recommendation
